Hello, dear users.

I just wanted to point out, that over the next few days, and perhaps even longer - you will be seeing some changes to both the stylistic layout, and design of our little subverse, and maybe even more! I'm still on the hunt for some good moderators, to assist in the day to day maintenance and running of /v/bartending - but, most prominently, you will be noticing the CSS Edits done by a very kind Voater @shockedtree. Already you can probably see the new /v/bartending logo! Which I am incredibly excited about! It was designed by the magnificent @JesusPizzeria, and all compliments and credit can be directed towards both of these fine individuals! If you have any questions, or wish to be involved in the process of making this sub everything it can be, please feel free to contact me @Byr, any time! I respond to all messages, and queries.

I'm very proud of what this sub has become, and excited to see what more we can do, and it all comes down to you guys, the subscribers, the people that saw 'the little sub that could,' and decided it was something you wanted to be a part of. I couldn't be happier with the results so far, and it's only been active for 5 Days!

Continue to get involved, post questions, post recipes, post helpful stories that will give some real background into what bartending can be, as a career and as an art form. I know that a lot of you are hesitant to submit anything - whether it's just the typical lurking mindset, or you're afraid that your questions or posts may be wrong or uninteresting. I can tell you, with a 100% guarantee, that you will find nothing but honest, hard-working people here; ready to lend a hand, or praise your contribution! I won't let it happen any other way.

It's the absolute last thing I expect, but, I want you all to understand that I am available (as often as I can get online,) to take care of issues, answer questions, or deal with the unsavory. This is your subverse, this is your place to learn about Bartending and Mixology. I am but a humble servant, ready to fight the good fight - and bring you the most up to date, correct, and educational information.

Thank you all for everything you do, and for just being who you are. You are valued here.

-Byr

CSS Edits may be up at times, and down at others, while finishing touches are made. So, if you don't see any of the new changes - either change your settings to allow custom subverse styles, or check again later on.
